citations.assessment: The full narrative is at 3:4:3 in the checked text. It names Eliezer, Yehoshua and Akiva gathering for the sages and explicitly has the donor sell half of the remaining field and give them the proceeds. Heilprin’s Hebrew compresses this to sold a field and gave them half. Preserve the received halakhah number as an edition issue and the narrative distinction as evidence.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
